# awscc_glue_connection_type (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Glue::ConnectionType



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `connection_properties` (Attributes) Configuration that defines the base URL and additional request parameters needed during connection creation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_properties))
- `connection_type` (String) The name of the connection type. Must be prefixed with REST-.
- `connection_type_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the registered connection type.
- `connector_authentication_configuration` (Attributes) Configuration that defines supported authentication types and required properties. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector_authentication_configuration))
- `description` (String) A description of the connection type.
- `integration_type` (String) The integration type for the connection. Currently only REST is supported.
- `rest_configuration` (Attributes) Configuration for HTTP request and response handling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rest_configuration))
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags to assign to the connection type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
